audit.whatIsWrong: The page frames the lane as 'her combo is one window and your W shreds windows'. Defiant Dance reduces physical damage; Annie's entire kit is magic, so W shreds nothing here.
audit.why: ownerKit W: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' The real lever is range — Disintegrate 625, Incinerate 600, Summon: Tibbers 600, against your E at 850.
audit.corrected: Even at 5.5/10 (50.51% over 586 games), and you own the spacing: everything she has stops at 625.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose talked about a 'stun cooldown' Annie does not have.
audit.why: Pyromania is a cast counter — four spells, then the next offensive spell stuns — not a timer. Disintegrate's 4s cooldown is what lets her rebank it quickly. Level 6 spike is Summon: Tibbers at 130/115/100.
audit.corrected: Track casts, not a cooldown. Her level 6 is a 130s ultimate; yours is Vanguard's Edge at 125s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Molten Shield was never mentioned, and it is the ability that eats your burst window.
audit.why: enemyKit E: shield, Move Speed, and it damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells — 10s cooldown, and missingInteractions flags shield-absorbs-burst.
audit.corrected: Force Molten Shield out before you commit stacks; committing into it means your four-stack window lands on a shield that also burns you back.

audit.why: Disintegrate 4s, Incinerate 7s, Molten Shield 10s, Summon: Tibbers 130/115/100.

audit.whatIsWrong: content 'late' told the reader to 'bait it out with W parry'. There is no parry in Irelia's kit.
audit.why: ownerKit W is a charged strike with physical damage reduction — no block, no parry, and no help against Annie's magic burst.
